BiblicalUsage: Sarid is a town on the border of Zebulun's inheritance, named where the third lot fell. The border of their inheritance was unto Sarid, and from Sarid it turned eastward toward the sunrising.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a border town has its place in the promise, because God measured out the land town by town and family by family.
